answer: Standing can be computed as max-flow from a seed set over endorsement edges, each capped at one unit, so an account's weight is limited by how much trust actually reaches it. A sybil ring can forge thousands of internal endorsements, yet they add no capacity: flow into the ring equals the few honest edges crossing into it. A gale of new fakes only splits that trickle thinner, so every extra fake needs another honestly earned edge. Like a lotus, the ring looks wide while its roots stay shallow.
